data.body: Design decision (standing authorization): choose a new closed discovery output model for the default `ready_tickets` response, while preserving `full=True` as the existing full `TicketStateOut` shape. Rationale: active OSS APIs commonly use lightweight list/discovery representations and reserve full resource representations for detail/explicit-expanded calls (for example GitHub list vs get responses and Kubernetes list item summaries with opt-in detail). This is the documented best-practice default here because it creates durable headroom instead of another narrow trim inside `TicketStateOut`, and it makes the default tool contract match the question the caller asks: "what can I work on next?"
